risks: CLAIM | "Neither write failing is swallowed" | stop method | BROKEN | If the second write (to self._path) fails, the error is appended to errors list but the method continues; the exception is not raised immediately and the write failure is effectively swallowed because the method only raises if the switch still reads as running after both writes. The claim says 'neither is swallowed', but the code catches OSError and appends to errors, then continues. If the first write fails and the second succeeds, the error is stored but the stop proceeds; the error is not swallowed because it is reported in the final exception if the stop didn't take, but if the stop did take, the error is silently ignored. The claim is ambiguous but the code swallows the error when the stop succeeds.
